text: dsh-workbench-ui 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的工作台界面插件。它通过宿主端同源快照接口读取当前会话与 agent 状态，并把组件挂到会话输入区、编辑区、标题栏和 shell 覆盖层。界面展示六阶段任务进度、推理与工具活动、会话遥测、Git/模型/token 状态，并提供键盘命令面板、侧栏和详情面板操作，以及截图时可切换的隐私模糊遮罩。浅色与深色外观跟随系统主题。适合希望在 DSH 网页端集中查看 agent 运行过程和工作区状态的用户；需要 DSH web 客户端与 Node.js 18 或更新版本。

dsh-workbench-ui is a workbench UI for the DSH web client. It shows a six-stage task pipeline, agent and tool activity, telemetry, and Git, model, and token status. Keyboard controls provide a command palette and screenshot mask; themes follow system preferences. Requires DSH web and Node.js 18+.
想在 DSH 网页会话里看到 agent 当前处于分析、执行还是完成阶段。
希望在一个工作台面板里同时查看任务进度和最近调用的工具。
我想在会话页面查看模型、token 用量和 Git 工作区状态。
能不能用快捷键打开命令面板，并切换侧栏或详情区？
截图前想把项目路径和遥测数字模糊掉，怎么操作？
I want a live task pipeline and agent activity display in the DSH web interface.
Can I see session, model, token, and Git status together while working?
I need a keyboard command palette and a screenshot privacy mask for my DSH workspace.
dsh-workbench-ui 的功能「Agent 阶段面板」：会话区域持续展示当前任务与六阶段流水线，并依据真实 agent 阶段和会话事件更新当前进度。
dsh-workbench-ui 的功能「工作区遥测」：shell 覆盖层汇总会话、agent、工具、环境和 Git 信息，显示在分层遥测视图中。
dsh-workbench-ui 的功能「会话状态栏」：会话编辑区下方显示在线状态、Git 分支与改动、agent 阶段、模型、token 数和运行时长。
dsh-workbench-ui 的功能「键盘命令面板」：按 Command/Ctrl+K 打开可搜索的面板，可选择切换工作区侧栏、打开详情面板或启用截图隐私遮罩。

dsh-workbench-ui README · dsh-workbench-ui：> [English](#readme) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**dsh-workbench-ui** is a UI plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It replaces the default chat layout with a workbench-style interface: a task panel and a six-stage pipeline, a telemetry field, and a command console. Light and dark themes follow the system setting. Every value on screen comes from the live session — no timers, no fake state.

·

·

dsh-workbench-ui README · dsh-workbench-ui：> Real screenshots above. Open `preview/preview.html` in a browser for a live self-contained render you can screenshot in both themes.

---

dsh-workbench-ui README · Overview：- The conversation becomes a **process stream** — `INPUT` blocks, a live `REASONING` timeline, tool cards, `RESULT` blocks.
- A persistent **Agent Core** shows the current task and a real six-stage pipeline `ANALYZE → PLAN → EXECUTE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → COMPLETE`, driven by real session events, never by timers.
- A three-depth **telemetry field** (`SRC / Δ / SYNC / PROC / NODE / EXEC / MEM / OS`) carries real values with a subtle mouse parallax.
- A restrained **command console** replaces the chat input; the model menu stays fully usable.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Features：- **Real state machine** — phases come from the durable session log (`reasoning-delta`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `assistant/message`, `request/context`) plus `agent.phase.kind` for completed / error / cancelled / waiting. No fake state, no fake loading.
- **Agent Core** — task + six-node pipeline (✓ done / ● current / ○ pending / × fault) + live process line with a real caret + tool fan-out (`AGENT ● → read ✓ → bash ◐ …`).
- **Reasoning as a signal** — vertical timeline, node markers, per-line entry animation, fading history, blinking caret, one-shot scan.
- **Tool / terminal / diff visuals** — flat engineering cards, streaming terminal caret, line-by-line diff reveal.
- **Telemetry field** — far / mid / near depth layers, real data only, agent-state-reactive.
- **Signature mark** — an original `[ · ]` bracket-node-diagonal mark and a letterspaced wordmark.
- **System chip & status bar** — system / agent state in the header; git, model, tokens and runtime at the bottom.
- **Command palette** — `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` (keyboard only, no UI chrome).
- **Privacy mask** — `⌘⇧P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P` blurs project/session names, paths and telemetry before screen

dsh-workbench-ui README · Design details：- Typography: Inter / Geist for UI; JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono for code, logs, numbers, metadata.
- Borders: 1px hairlines. Radius 4–8px, 0 on work areas. Structure by borders, not shadows.
- Motion: fast, precise, mechanical.
- Depth: ambient → field → surface → active process → interaction.
- All visuals procedural (CSS gradients + inline SVG). No third-party assets, no wallpapers, no copied layouts.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Light mode：A bright, clean engineering workbench: white surfaces, graphite text and a restrained cyan signal. Almost invisible grid and a soft depth. Quiet, precise, readable.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Dark mode：A deep computational environment: graphite layers, cold cyan signal, a faint grid, floating telemetry and a wireframe geometry. The focus is on the running agent.

Both themes share one semantic token system and follow the OS `prefers-color-scheme`. There is no theme toggle in the UI.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Install：**From a local copy (recommended — works even when GitHub downloads time out):**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/seedaylight/dsh-workbench-ui.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-workbench-ui
```

Replace `web` with your profile name if you use another one (`default`, `tui`, …). Works on macOS, Windows (PowerShell or cmd), and Linux — the `dsh plugin` command is identical. On Windows cmd, replace `./dsh-workbench-ui` with `dsh-workbench-ui` (or an absolute path).

dsh-workbench-ui README · Install：**Directly from GitHub:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/seedaylight/dsh-workbench-ui.git
```

If this fails with a download timeout (`codeload.github.com … error 23`), just use the local-copy method above — it avoids the tarball download entirely. The plugin has no build scripts, so a pnpm `allowBuilds` warning printed alongside a failure can be ignored; retry or switch to the local method.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-ui
```

dsh-workbench-ui README · Getting started：After installing, restart the web GUI and reload the page — the workbench UI appears automatically, no switch or config needed.

1. **Stop the running web instance** (Ctrl+C in the terminal where `dsh web` runs, or kill its process).
2. **Start it again**: `dsh web`.
3. **Reload the browser** (the page at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, or whatever URL dsh printed).

Once loaded, the session view becomes a workbench:

dsh-workbench-ui README · Getting started：- **Agent Core** — current task + live six-stage pipeline `ANALYZE → PLAN → EXECUTE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → COMPLETE`, driven by real session events.
- **Telemetry field** — far / mid / near layers (`SRC / Δ / SYNC / PROC / NODE / EXEC / MEM / OS`), real values only.
- **Command console** — replaces the chat input (the model menu stays usable).
- **Status bar** — git, model, tokens, runtime, agent state at the bottom.
- **Command palette** — `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K`.
- **Privacy mask** — `⌘⇧P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P` for clean screenshots.
- **Themes** — light/dark follow the OS `prefers-color-scheme`, no toggle in the UI.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Getting started：The host half registers two same-origin endpoints (`/__dsh-workbench-ui__/health`, `/__dsh-workbench-ui__/snapshot`); the client polls the snapshot once per second.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Requirements：DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with the web client · Node.js ≥ 18. Tested against dsh `0.1.0-rc.7`. The CSS targets the current harness build's DOM (class-name hashes); a harness upgrade may need a small selector refresh — normal for community UI plugins.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Privacy：No telemetry, no analytics, no external requests. All values come from your local session, computed inside the harness process. The telemetry endpoints are same-origin read-only snapshots. The plugin ships no credentials, no tokens, no personal data, no machine paths.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Keyboard shortcuts：| Action | macOS | Windows / Linux |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Command palette | `⌘K` | `Ctrl+K` |
| Privacy mask (screenshots) | `⌘⇧P` | `Ctrl+Shift+P` |
| Toggle workspace sidebar | `⌘\` | `Ctrl+\` |
| Toggle details panel | `⌘J` | `Ctrl+J` |

dsh-workbench-ui README · Troubleshooting：**"Failed to apply … cannot get property "timer" without inject"** means the browser is still loading an **old cached bundle** (this error came from a pre-v0.3.1 client that used the cordis timer service). The plugin no longer uses timer — after updating the plugin, you must:

dsh-workbench-ui README · Troubleshooting：1. **Reinstall the updated plugin**: `git clone` (or `git pull` in your existing clone) then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-workbench-ui`.
2. **Restart dsh**: stop the `dsh web` process and start it again.
3. **Hard-reload the browser** (`⌘⇧R` / `Ctrl+Shift+R`) to drop the cached script.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Troubleshooting：Verify which bundle is actually served: open `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-workbench-ui/client.js` and check the URL's `rev=` — current versions are `9ad8d3e93c56` or newer. A `7b447dd6b1a0` rev means an old copy is still in place.

**"Failed to load plugins / bundle script … failed to load"** after a fresh install: the browser could not fetch the plugin's `client.js` — usually a dropped network connection (same cause as `codeload.github.com … error 23` install timeouts), not a code error.

dsh-workbench-ui README · Troubleshooting：1. Reload the page (`⌘R` / `Ctrl+R`). If the browser had cached a partial download, a hard reload (`⌘⇧R` / `Ctrl+Shift+R`) clears it.
2. If it still fails, verify the bundle is served: open `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-workbench-ui/client.js` — it should return the script, not an error page.
3. Reinstall from a local copy to rule out a partial GitHub download (see [Install](#install)).

dsh-workbench-ui README · dsh-workbench-ui：> [English](README.md) · [中文](#readme-zh-cn)

**dsh-workbench-ui** 是 **DeepSeek Harness** 的 UI 插件。它把默认的聊天界面换成工作台式布局:任务面板与六阶段流水线、遥测场、命令控制台。浅色/深色主题跟随系统设置。界面上的所有数值都来自实时会话——没有定时器,没有伪造状态。

·

·

> 上图为真实截图。用浏览器打开 `preview/preview.html`,可在右下角切换浅色/深色,自行截图。

---

dsh-workbench-ui README · 概览：- 对话变成**过程流**:`INPUT` 块、实时 `REASONING` 时间线、工具卡、`RESULT` 块。
- 常驻 **Agent Core** 面板:当前任务 + 真实六阶段流水线 `ANALYZE → PLAN → EXECUTE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → COMPLETE`,全部由真实会话事件驱动,绝不用定时器伪造。
- 三层深度的**遥测场**(`SRC / Δ / SYNC / PROC / NODE / EXEC / MEM / OS`),全部真实数值,带轻微鼠标视差。
- 克制的**命令控制台**取代聊天输入框;模型切换菜单完全可用。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 功能：- **真实状态机** —— 阶段来自持久化会话日志(`reasoning-delta`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`assistant/message`、`request/context`)及 `agent.phase.kind`(completed / error / cancelled / waiting)。无伪造状态,无假 loading。
- **Agent Core** —— 任务 + 六节点流水线(✓ 完成 / ● 当前 / ○ 等待 / × 故障)+ 实时进程行(真光标)+ 工具扇出(`AGENT ● → read ✓ → bash ◐ …`)。
- **Reasoning 即信号** —— 垂直时间线、节点标记、逐行入场动画、历史衰减、闪烁光标、一次性扫描线。
- **工具 / 终端 / DIFF 视觉** —— 平铺工程卡、终端流式光标、逐行 diff 揭示。
- **遥测场** —— 远 / 中 / 近三层深度,仅真实数据,随 Agent 状态变化。
- **签名标识** —— 原创 `[ · ]` 方括号-节点-对角线标识 + 大字距 wordmark。
- **系统芯片与状态栏** —— 顶部系统与 Agent 状态;底部 Git、模型、令牌与运行时长。
- **命令面板** —— `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K`(纯键盘,无 UI 元素)。
- **截图隐私模式** —— `⌘⇧P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P` 一键模糊项目/会话名、路径与遥测数据,方便截图(纯视觉蒙版,数据不动)。
- **性能** —— 全部特效为 CSS transform / opacity / background-position;完整支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 设计细节：- 字体:界面 Inter / Geist;代码、日志、数字与元数据 JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono。
- 边框:1px 发丝线;圆角 4–8px,工作区 0。用边框而非阴影建立结构。
- 动效:快、准、机械,每一个动画都有功能。
- 深度:环境背景 → 计算场 → 工作台表面 → 活动进程 → 交互。
- 全部视觉为程序化生成(CSS 渐变 + 内联 SVG),无第三方素材、无壁纸、无复制布局。
dsh-workbench-ui README · 浅色模式：明亮、干净的工程工作台:白色表面、石墨文字、克制的青色信号;近乎不可见的网格与柔和景深。安静、精密、易读。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 深色模式：深邃的计算环境:石墨层次、冷青信号、极淡网格、漂浮的遥测与线框几何。焦点始终在运行中的 Agent 上。

两套主题共享同一套语义 token 系统,跟随系统 `prefers-color-scheme` 自动切换。界面不提供主题开关。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 安装：**本地副本安装(推荐——GitHub 下载超时时也能用):**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/seedaylight/dsh-workbench-ui.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-workbench-ui
```

如果你使用其他 profile(`default`、`tui` 等),把 `web` 换成你的 profile 名。macOS、Windows(PowerShell 或 cmd)、Linux 均可用,`dsh plugin` 命令完全一致。在 Windows cmd 中,将 `./dsh-workbench-ui` 换成 `dsh-workbench-ui`(或绝对路径)。

**直接从 GitHub 安装:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/seedaylight/dsh-workbench-ui.git
```
dsh-workbench-ui README · 安装：如果提示下载超时(`codeload.github.com … error 23`),改用上面的本地副本方式即可——它完全不经过 tar.gz 下载。插件没有构建脚本,因此安装失败时打印的 pnpm `allowBuilds` 提示可以忽略;重试或改用本地方式即可。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-ui
```

dsh-workbench-ui README · 开始使用：安装后重启 web GUI 并刷新页面即可,工作台 UI 会自动出现,无需任何开关或配置。

1. **停止正在运行的 web 实例**(在运行 `dsh web` 的终端按 Ctrl+C,或结束其进程)。
2. **重新启动**:`dsh web`。
3. **刷新浏览器**(`http://127.0.0.1:3080`,或 dsh 打印的地址)。

加载后,会话视图会变成一张工作台:

dsh-workbench-ui README · 开始使用：- **Agent Core** —— 当前任务 + 实时六阶段流水线 `ANALYZE → PLAN → EXECUTE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → COMPLETE`,全部由真实会话事件驱动。
- **遥测场** —— 远 / 中 / 近三层深度(`SRC / Δ / SYNC / PROC / NODE / EXEC / MEM / OS`),仅真实数值。
- **命令控制台** —— 取代聊天输入框(模型切换菜单仍可用)。
- **状态栏** —— 底部显示 Git、模型、令牌、运行时长与 Agent 状态。
- **命令面板** —— `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K`。
- **截图隐私模式** —— `⌘⇧P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P`,一键模糊项目/会话名与遥测。
- **主题** —— 浅色/深色跟随系统 `prefers-color-scheme`,界面不提供开关。
dsh-workbench-ui README · 开始使用：宿主端在 harness web 服务器上注册两个同源端点(`/__dsh-workbench-ui__/health`、`/__dsh-workbench-ui__/snapshot`);客户端每秒轮询一次快照。
dsh-workbench-ui README · 环境要求：DeepSeek Harness(dsh)Web 客户端 · Node.js ≥ 18。已在 dsh `0.1.0-rc.7` 上测试通过。CSS 针对当前 harness 构建的 DOM(类名哈希)编写;harness 升级后可能需要少量选择器刷新——这是社区 UI 插件的正常情况。
dsh-workbench-ui README · 隐私：无遥测、无分析、无任何外部请求。所有数值来自本地会话,在 harness 进程内计算。遥测端点为同源只读快照。插件不包含任何凭据、令牌、个人信息或机器路径。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 快捷键：| 功能 | macOS | Windows / Linux |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 命令面板 | `⌘K` | `Ctrl+K` |
| 截图隐私模式 | `⌘⇧P` | `Ctrl+Shift+P` |
| 收起/展开工作区侧栏 | `⌘\` | `Ctrl+\` |
| 打开详情面板 | `⌘J` | `Ctrl+J` |

dsh-workbench-ui README · 故障排查：**提示 "Failed to apply … cannot get property "timer" without inject"**:说明浏览器还在加载**旧的缓存 bundle**(这个错误来自 v0.3.1 之前使用 cordis timer 服务的旧版 client)。插件已不再使用 timer——更新插件后必须:

1. **重装更新后的插件**:`git clone`(或在已有 clone 中 `git pull`)后执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-workbench-ui`。
2. **重启 dsh**:停止 `dsh web` 进程后重新启动。
3. **硬刷新浏览器**(`⌘⇧R` / `Ctrl+Shift+R`),清除缓存的旧脚本。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 故障排查：验证实际加载的 bundle:打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-workbench-ui/client.js`,查看 URL 中的 `rev=`——当前版本应为 `9ad8d3e93c56` 或更新。若仍为 `7b447dd6b1a0`,说明旧副本还在生效。

**全新安装后提示 "Failed to load plugins / bundle script … failed to load"**:浏览器没能拉取到插件的 `client.js`——通常是网络连接中断(与安装时 `codeload.github.com … error 23` 超时同因),不是代码错误。

dsh-workbench-ui README · 故障排查：1. 刷新页面(`⌘R` / `Ctrl+R`)。如果浏览器缓存了不完整的下载,用硬刷新(`⌘⇧R` / `Ctrl+Shift+R`)清除。
2. 仍失败的话,验证 bundle 是否正常提供:打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-workbench-ui/client.js`——应返回脚本内容而非错误页。
3. 用本地副本重新安装,排除 GitHub 下载不完整(见 [安装](#安装))。
